purpose: Record source, compilation, encoding, and editorial anomalies without silently rewriting unresolved source meaning.

entries.source_text: The interfaces comprise seven basic service groups plus an eighth support group; the same passage names data distribution management as DMM.
entries.rendered_text: Preserved for adjudication; no service-group count or DDM/DMM terminology was silently normalized.
entries.reason: The listed groups and terminology do not agree internally.

entries.source_text: Footnote markers 9 and 10 appear without visible footnote text.
entries.rendered_text: Markers retained only where present in the source projection; missing note bodies are not invented.
entries.reason: The extracted source contains references whose note bodies are absent from the supplied material.

entries.location: FOM, FDD, DDM terms and figure captions
entries.source_text: Private-use glyphs surround some abbreviations and caption parentheses.
entries.rendered_text: Ordinary parentheses and Unicode text characters are used.
entries.reason: Private-use characters are not stable publication text.

entries.source_text: Figure captions are duplicated or embedded in the imported artwork region.
entries.rendered_text: Artwork is caption-free and each figure receives one generated Requirements Lab caption.
entries.reason: Source-page furniture and generated captions were being composed together.

entries.rendered_text: Rendered with an explicit separating space after the sentence; source anomaly retained in this ledger.
entries.reason: The token appears to lack an expected separating space or punctuation.

entries.rendered_text: Rendered as 'Directed interaction table (complete)' after source spelling repair; original retained in this ledger.
entries.reason: Likely spelling defect, but the corrected term must be verified before application.

entries.source_text: A parenthetical Comment note is embedded in a normative bullet.
entries.rendered_text: Removed from normative production prose; original editorial note retained in this ledger.
entries.reason: An editorial instruction is not part of the normative sentence grammar.

entries.source_text: The supplied-argument list uses a) twice.
entries.rendered_text: Enumeration remains source-controlled pending comparison with the authoritative source.
entries.reason: Repeated enumeration may be a transcription defect or an intentional source label.

entries.source_text: One subsection states Java 11; a later subsection says Java 5 is assumed.
entries.rendered_text: Both statements are retained with provenance; no version is selected silently.
entries.reason: The implementation baseline is internally inconsistent.

entries.source_text: Standardized time-class names vary in capitalization while filenames are case-sensitive.
entries.rendered_text: Technical tokens are rendered case-preserving pending validation against the supplied API artifact.
entries.reason: A capitalization correction could change an API identifier.

entries.source_text: Annex A directs readers to Annex E for the Federate Protocol API, and a protocol paragraph refers to Annex E files; the API appears in Annex D.
entries.rendered_text: Rendered with both Federate Protocol references corrected to Annex D; original source wording retained in this ledger.
entries.reason: The Federate Protocol API and its files are in normative Annex D; Annex E is the rationale annex and does not contain the API files.

entries.source_text: Annex E is marked normative while disclaiming implementation requirements; Annex F is informative while containing shall statements.
entries.rendered_text: Classifications are not changed without source adjudication.
entries.reason: Annex status and internal normative language conflict.

entries.source_text: Figure 1 is listed with a source page rather than its generated Requirements Lab page.
entries.rendered_text: Figure-page references are generated from labels and anchors.
entries.reason: Pagination changes when source figures become generated publication pages.

entries.source_text: The source-page artwork association for Figures 3–5 was ambiguous in an earlier build: Figure 4 was at risk of receiving the Normal Activity Permitted artwork while Figure 5 carried the joined-state source caption.
entries.rendered_text: Figure 3 is Lifetime of a federate, Figure 4 is Joined federate state, and Figure 5 is Normal Activity Permitted state. Each mapping is independently represented by its semantic record and generated PlantUML artwork.
entries.reason: The generated caption and the state-chart source association must agree; source-page extraction order is not a sufficient mapping authority.
